The only cell identifiers are ordinary 10x barcodes, which are per-run and cannot link across days

GSE165176.verdict_reason: The sort is genuinely orthogonal to RNA and IS the fate call, but 47 of 71 cultures yield BOTH fractions at the same timepoint, so marker identity is a within-culture subpopulation label rather than a culture outcome. No FACS proportions exist to build a culture-level quantity instead, only 6 unsorted early samples exist (all day 0), and every donor reaches day 54 with the same marker — no outcome variation. A future culture-level target cannot be defined from these files

q1_what_was_sorted.evidence: antibody surface-marker sort; the cell-type characteristic tracks the marker 1:1 (['CD13 -> cell type: Failing to reprogram fibroblast', 'SSEA4 -> cell type: Reprogramming fibroblast', 'SSEA4 -> cell type: iPSC', 'UNSORTED -> cell type: Dermal fibroblast']), so the SORT IS the fate assignment and is measured independently of RNA

q2_q3_both_fractions_same_culture.evidence: 47 of 71 donor x day x experiment cultures yield BOTH an SSEA4 and a CD13 fraction. The culture does not BECOME one of them — it contains both at once, so the marker is a WITHIN-CULTURE SUBPOPULATION label, not a culture-level outcome

q4_q5_sampling.evidence: each sample is a sorted harvest at one day; nothing in the protocols links a harvested population forward to a later harvest of the same cells

q6_q8_unsorted_early_samples.evidence: 6 unsorted samples, all day [0] — these are the ONLY prediction-time-valid early observations, because every other sample is already marker-sorted

q7_early_input_already_sorted.evidence: 118 of 124 samples are already SSEA4/CD13 sorted. Using a later marker identity as the target for a sorted early input is LEAKAGE: the input was selected on the very phenotype being predicted

q9_facs_proportions.evidence: no percentage/proportion/frequency/FACS-count quantity anywhere in the series metadata; the corpus ships RNA matrices FROM the two sorted fractions, not the sort statistics. So a culture-level target such as `early RNA -> later %SSEA4+` cannot be constructed

q10_terminal_outcome.evidence: no colony count, reprogramming efficiency, survival or other terminal assay in the metadata; the only orthogonal readout is the sort itself

q11_effective_n.evidence: Exp1 covers days [7, 9, 11, 13, 15] and Exp2 days [0, 11, 21, 29, 34, 40, 47, 54], overlapping only at [11]. They are TIME BLOCKS of one study, not independent replicates of the same experiment, so donors x experiments OVERSTATES the unit count. Effective n = 6 donors

terminal_day_outcome_variation.evidence: at day 54 all 6 donors appear and only ['SSEA4'] is present — every donor reaches the terminal timepoint with the same marker, so there is NO outcome contrast to predict
